systems.country_label: Système de E-Justice (Casier Judiciaire, Jugement Supplétif)
systems.owner: Ministry of Justice and Human Rights (MJDH)
systems.tiers: Planned: initiative 4.4.16 of the Guinée Digitale 2023-2027 strategy, costed at 2.75 million US dollars over 12 months

note: Passages file; the national digital strategy plans a justice ministry e-justice system covering the criminal record and supplementary judgments, class identification by its criminal-record content; the 'fichier central' is a register of critical infrastructure. The passages name no police or gendarmerie system.
